integrity: All infinite claims are symbolic. Two finite graph algorithms corroborate explicit thresholds; they do not constitute an exhaustive search of infinite graphs. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to integer base b>=2 and shift c>=0. Girth of the full infinite sum-incidence graph is proved symbolically. The Abelian pattern Sturmian equivalence invokes a published general forest characterization. Does not compute nonminimal complexity values in cyclic cases. Originality has residual risk from a not fully accessible examples subsection.
title: Exact girth trichotomy for shifted geometric supports and Abelian pattern Sturmian words
